text: 下周外盘看点丨 美国10月CPI释放什么信号，地缘因素如何扰动全球市场 市场是否消化了民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜对中东局势、油价以及科技板块的影响？俄美乌三方会谈等地缘事件会不会扰动风险偏好？
text_en: Next week's overseas highlights: What signal will US October CPI send, and how will geopolitical factors disturb global markets? Has the market digested the impact of the Democrats' landslide victory in the US midterm elections on the Middle East situation, oil prices and the tech sector? Will geopolitical events such as the trilateral talks among Russia, the US and Ukraine disrupt risk appetite?
